info.title: WP License Captain REST API
info.description: Versioned v1 contract for license activation, entitlement checks, Stripe webhook receipt, and premium updates. All date-time values are UTC in the form "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS". Every response of this API, including errors, is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. Error messages are stable English texts and are not translated: clients decide by the error code (schema ErrorCode), never by the message.

200.description: Activation created or idempotently retrieved. data is an EntitlementData object. A staging request on a host that is unrelated to its live site is counted as a live site: environment in the signed data is then "production".

post.description: Not HMAC-authenticated; possession of the license key authorizes it. Error codes: 400 invalid_activation (data.fields lists the rejected fields), development_site_invalid, staging_parent_required, rest_missing_callback_param, rest_invalid_param; 401 invalid_key; 403 product_mismatch, license_expired, license_suspended, license_revoked, license_inactive (data.license_status); 409 site_limit (data.site_limit, data.site_count), staging_limit, development_limit (data.development_limit, data.development_count), staging_parent_invalid, staging_site_invalid, installation_conflict, activation_deactivated, activation_conflict; 429 rate_limited; 500 activation_failed, server_configuration; 503 retry_later, rate_limit_store_unavailable.

200.description: Activation was deactivated, or had already been deactivated (idempotent). data is a DeactivationData object.

delete.description: Error codes: 401 invalid_request_signature, request_expired, activation_not_found, installation_secret_invalid; 403 activation_mismatch; 409 site_mismatch (the site_url in the body is not the activated site; nothing was deactivated), deactivation_failed, request_replayed; 429 rate_limited; 503 retry_later, rate_limit_store_unavailable, replay_store_unavailable.

post.summary: Get current license status and feature rights

200.description: Signed current entitlement snapshot (EntitlementData). An installation whose activation was released also gets 200: activation_status and license_status are then "deactivated", access is false and entitlements is empty.

post.description: Error codes: 400 rest_invalid_param; 401 invalid_request_signature, request_expired, activation_not_found, installation_secret_invalid; 404 license_not_found; 409 request_replayed; 429 rate_limited; 503 rate_limit_store_unavailable, replay_store_unavailable.

post.summary: Check for an authorized premium update

200.description: Signed update metadata or signed no-update result (UpdateCheckData).

post.description: Missing or non-string product_key/current_version are rejected with 400 rest_missing_callback_param or rest_invalid_param before the request is authenticated. Error codes: 401 invalid_request_signature, request_expired, activation_not_found, installation_secret_invalid; 403 license_inactive (no access, or the license belongs to another product), activation_deactivated (data.signed carries a SignedEnvelope with DeactivatedData); 409 request_replayed; 429 rate_limited; 503 package_configuration_invalid, download_token_error, rate_limit_store_unavailable, replay_store_unavailable.

get.summary: Consume a short-lived, one-use update grant

302.description: Redirect to an allow-listed HTTPS package URL. Sent with Cache-Control: no-store and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.

404.description: Grant is invalid, expired, consumed, or no longer entitled, or the package host is no longer trusted. Sent without a body. A path that is not 64 lower-case hex characters does not match the route and is answered by WordPress with the JSON error rest_no_route (404).

post.summary: Receive a signed Stripe PaymentIntent event

200.description: Event recorded, acknowledged as duplicate, or ignored.

400.description: Invalid signature, body, or required renewal metadata.

get.summary: Stream a locally stored release package for a short-lived, one-use token

200.description: The package ZIP (application/zip). Sent with Cache-Control: no-store.

404.description: Unknown, expired or already used token (no body); a malformed token does not match the route (JSON error rest_no_route).

InstallationHmac.name: X-WPLC-Signature
InstallationHmac.description: Requires X-WPLC-Installation-Id, X-WPLC-Timestamp and X-WPLC-Nonce as well. Sign uppercase method, REST route, timestamp, nonce and SHA-256 of raw body, newline-separated, with the installation secret using HMAC-SHA-256.

license_key.description: Case-insensitive. Everything outside A-Z, 0-9 and "-" is ignored and typographic dashes count as "-", so a key pasted with line breaks or spaces is accepted.

installation_id.description: UUID generated by the client; compared in lower case.

installation_secret.description: Random secret generated by the client. Validated, never rewritten: any other character is rejected with 400 invalid_activation.

site_url.description: http or https URL of the site without credentials, query string or fragment; no whitespace or control characters; at most 255 bytes after normalization.

environment.description: Exact, lower-case value. Anything else is rejected with 400 invalid_activation instead of being treated as production.

product_version.description: Stored up to 30 characters; longer values are cut.

wp_version.description: Stored up to 30 characters; longer values are cut.

php_version.description: Stored up to 30 characters; longer values are cut.

product_version.description: Stored up to 30 characters; longer values are cut. Omitted or empty values keep the stored one.

wp_version.description: Stored up to 30 characters; longer values are cut. Omitted or empty values keep the stored one.

php_version.description: Stored up to 30 characters; longer values are cut. Omitted or empty values keep the stored one.

site_url.description: Current address of the site. When sent, the signed data contains site_match.

data.description: Kept for clients that predate payload; current clients must read the data member of the verified payload instead. Response-specific payload, see EntitlementData, DeactivationData, DeactivatedData and UpdateCheckData. Entitlement responses include activation_id, installation_id, activation_status, product_key, license_status, access, paid_until, access_until, grace_until, site_limit, site_count, environment, staging_parent_id, entitlements, server_time and cache_expires_at.

signature.description: Legacy: HMAC-SHA-256 over JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES encoding of data using the installation secret. Not bound to a request; superseded by payload_signature. Still sent for old client copies; new clients must not accept it in place of payload_signature.

payload.description: The exact JSON text that was signed: an object with the members data (same content as the data field) and nonce. nonce echoes the X-WPLC-Nonce header of an authenticated request; for POST /activations it is the installation_id of the request. Verify payload_signature over these bytes before decoding, then compare nonce with the value sent.

payload_signature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA-256 over the payload string as transmitted, keyed by the installation secret.

signature_ed25519.description: Legacy: base64 Ed25519 signature of the server over "wplc-response-v1\n{installation UUID, lower case}\n{JSON of data}". Not bound to a request; superseded by payload_signature_ed25519. Present when the server has a signing key.

payload_signature_ed25519.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature of the server over "wplc-response-v2\n{installation UUID, lower case}\n{payload}", where payload is the payload member exactly as transmitted. Covers the request nonce. Present when the server has a signing key. Clients that pin the server's public key must reject responses and cached snapshots without a valid signature.

key_id.description: First 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the signing public key.

code.description: One of ErrorCode for the license routes. The contract: clients decide by this value.

message.description: English, for logs. Not translated and not part of the contract; do not show it to end users unfiltered.

fields.description: invalid_activation: names of the rejected request fields.

retry_after.description: Seconds; rate_limited and retry_later. Also sent as Retry-After header.

server_time.description: request_expired: Unix time of the server, to detect a wrong client clock.

site_url.description: Address of the site that asks. When sent, it must be the activated site (ignoring scheme, a leading "www." and path case); otherwise 409 site_mismatch. Clients should always send it so a copy of the site cannot end the activation of the original.

LicenseStatus.description: active: paid and usable. past_due: an automatic renewal failed or is pending; access (and grace_until) tell whether the grace period still runs. expired: the paid period and any grace period are over. suspended: blocked by the shop (for example a payment dispute); may become active again. revoked: ended for good (refund). pending: not issued completely yet. deactivated: not a state of the license but of this installation: its activation was released; the client must stop and may activate again with a new installation ID.

product_key.description: Product the license was sold for. A client must reject data for another product.

access.description: Whether the license grants its rights right now. The only field a client needs to decide whether premium features run.

paid_until.description: End of the paid period, UTC; null for a license without an end.

access_until.description: UTC time at which access ends if nothing changes: paid_until, or grace_until when a grace period applies. null without access or for a license without an end.

grace_until.description: End of the renewal grace period, UTC, when one applies to this license (automatic renewal or past_due); else null. The license is inside its grace period when server_time is not before paid_until and access is true.

site_count.description: Active live (production) activations of the license.

staging_parent_id.description: activation_id of the live site a staging activation belongs to.

entitlements.description: Feature rights by key; empty without access.

site_match.description: Only when the request carried site_url: whether it is the activated site (ignoring scheme, a leading "www." and path case).

cache_expires_at.description: UTC. Until then the client may rely on this snapshot without reaching the server: server_time plus 14 days, but never later than access_until. After it the client must treat the license as without access until a new signed answer arrives.

DeactivatedData.description: EntitlementData of an installation whose activation was released: activation_status and license_status are "deactivated", access is false, entitlements is empty.

reason.description: Only with update_available false: no release is published for the product.

current_version.description: Only with update_available false: the version the client reported, which is the newest.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the ZIP; the client must verify it before installing.

download_expires_at.description: UTC; ten minutes after the check.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes of the license routes; the meaning of each code is listed in docs/API-V1.md. WordPress may add codes of its own (rest_no_route, rest_invalid_json).

ApiError.description: WordPress REST API error response. Sent with Cache-Control: no-store; 429 and 503 carry Retry-After.
